title: Beta-Carotene Supplements
subtitle: Evidence, dosing, safety, interactions, and practical considerations for beta-carotene supplements.
evidence_strength: Moderate; strong evidence for beta-carotene as vitamin A precursor and antioxidant with well-established physiology; mixed and inconclusive evidence on cancer prevention and chronic disease; consistent evidence of harm from high-dose supplements in smokers.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
